title: German Academic Scholarship Foundation: Doctoral Scholarships

provider.name: Studienstiftung des deutschen Volkes (German Academic Scholarship Foundation)

summary: Doctoral scholarships for highly qualified PhD students committed to social causes, providing 1,750 EUR monthly, research and health insurance allowances, and academic support programmes for research in Germany.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are eligible, as no subject restrictions are mentioned.

institutions.notes: Must be accepted to a doctoral programme at a German university where the thesis will also be submitted.

nationality.notes: If the doctoral programme is carried out at a German university, citizenship does not matter (applies to international candidates accepted to a German university).

residence.notes: Citizenship does not matter if the doctoral programme is carried out at a German university.

mandatory.text: The last academic degree should have been completed no longer than 4 years prior to submission of the application.
The doctoral candidate has been accepted for a doctoral programme at a German university where the thesis will also be submitted.
An exceptionally challenging and innovative scientific dissertation project that can be completed within a funding period of 3 years.
Appropriate supervision of the project and the doctoral candidate.
Successfully completed studies showing commitment and above-average marks.

preferences.text: Exceptional academic or artistic talents and personal qualities
Commitment to social causes beyond one's own interests

exceptions.text: The 4-year interval since the last degree can be justified by pregnancies or proven prolonged periods of serious illness or incapacity for work.
In justified cases, doctorates abroad can also be funded; this presupposes that the doctoral candidate has German citizenship or a university entrance qualification acquired in Germany.

funding.description: Grant amount of 1,750 EUR a month, comprising a basic monthly stipend of 1,650 EUR and a research allowance of 100 EUR a month. Scholars can also apply for a contribution towards health insurance (50 percent of documented costs up to a maximum of 100 EUR a month) and family/childcare allowances.
funding.duration: Funding can be granted for 3 years, with a 6-month extension possible (maximum 42 months, or up to 54 months for doctoral students with children).

application_rounds.notes: Calls are published approximately 8 months before each selection meeting and each call remains open for 2 weeks. The selection committee meets four times a year.

recurring_deadline_notes: The Studienstiftung publishes calls for applications approximately 8 months before each selection meeting. Each call remains open for 2 weeks. The Selection Committee for Doctoral Candidates meets four times a year.

steps.text: Pre-selection by the Studienstiftung to check formal conditions.
Assessment round including a specialist report and an interview report.
Discussion and decision at the meeting of the Selection Committee for Doctoral Candidates.

sources.title: German Academic Scholarship Foundation: Doctoral Scholarships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Supports international doctoral candidates pursuing a PhD programme physically at a German university where the thesis is submitted.

review_notes: Doctoral theses undertaken as part of a medical degree are not supported.
Funding for part-time doctoral degrees is not possible.
